social-mac-plate.png: Use case: luxury studio product photograph, clean plate for a Mac software campaign. One very large modern silver aluminum MacBook Pro, lid open; immaculate black glass blank display with thin uniform bezel, absolutely NO interface, NO type, no imagery on screen. 3:2 horizontal photograph, all four interior display corners clearly identifiable with the full display visible. Use an unusual near-front three-quarter angle, the camera about 12 degrees to the LEFT and just above the keyboard, and a deliberate 9 degree clockwise camera roll for an elegant graphic diagonal. A calm pale celadon green seamless studio cyclorama, subtle direction of daylight, non-glossy surface with fine contact shadow. Frame the laptop very large, filling ~84 percent of image width with the black display, very little empty air above its top edge, silver base and a small portion of black keyboard and trackpad in the lower quarter. The laptop elegantly bleeds toward the lower right, but screen stays entirely within the frame. Palm rest and thin leading aluminum lip have minute brushed-metal details and controlled mint reflections, strong edge contrast. Minimal art direction, medium-format studio photograph, restrained cool platinum palette, industrial detailing and fine realistic grain, one still life object only. No logo, no props, no desk clutter, no human, no caption, no graphical overlay, no flare, no teal neon. The screen must be a continuous perfectly empty very dark rectangle for perspective-tracked replacement in post.
social-pointer-plate.png: Premium contemporary industrial-design campaign still life photographed on a medium-format camera. Isolate ONE extraordinarily tactile aluminium object shaped exactly like a classic Mac mouse cursor arrow, a chunky but elegant three-dimensional cutout: the conventional seven-sided black mouse-arrow silhouette, sharp point oriented UP AND TO THE LEFT at 10 o’clock, tail down-right, the left edge almost vertical. Its broad top face is rich deep evergreen vitreous enamel with fine controlled studio highlights and a narrow mirror-polished silver chamfer. Sidewalls are machined brushed silver about 12 mm thick, softly reflecting seafoam ambient color. It is lying barely lifted above a continuous luminous pale seafoam tabletop (#D6EBE1), so its realistic contact shadow falls gently to the lower right. One beautifully lit physical design object, restrained, crisp, playful, with the precision of premium hi-fi equipment. No UI, no typography, no letters, no logo, no other shapes, no particles, no generic tech render patterns, no embossing. The pointer alone fills 70% of a square frame. Camera above the face at a shallow off-axis angle, pointing downward, show the broad enamel surface and precise silver edges. This is a product cutaway for a software advertising poster; ship a square color photograph. Not an arrow sign like a traffic arrow, exactly an asymmetrical mouse pointer with the notch and short stem.
